EXCAVATION AND SITE PREPARATION | | A1 | Excavation depth verification
Acceptance: Depth measured at multiple points; within ±150 mm of design; no under-excavation | Cl. 3.1 — Excavation to design depth | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: CBR test results ≥ design value; or plate load test bearing capacity ≥ design | Cl. 3.2 — Bearing capacity verification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Excavation slope and stability
Acceptance: Slopes per design angle; no slippage; water seepage controlled; temporary bracing if required | Cl. 3.3 — Slopes must be stable | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Dewatering and groundwater management
Acceptance: Pumping system operational; water table controlled; site remains dry; no erosion | Cl. 3.4 — Water control essential | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A5 | Excavation bottom surface condition
Acceptance: Bottom level within ±50 mm; firm and undisturbed; no soft spots; clean of debris | Cl. 3.5 — Level and firm bottom required | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. FOUNDATION REINFORCEMENT | | B1 | Reinforcement bar grades and sizes
Acceptance: Bar diameter and grade match design; test certificates available; no substitution | Cl. 4.1 — Steel grades as per design | OK

NA
HOLD | | B2 | Reinforcement placement and spacing
Acceptance: Spacing ±25 mm of design; covers verified; no bunching; ties/clamps secure | Cl. 4.2 — Bars positioned per design | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Concrete cover verification
Acceptance: Cover = design value ±10 mm; spacers placed every 1.0 m; no segregation at cover zone | Cl. 4.3 — Cover protects reinforcement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Lap length and splice conditions
Acceptance: Lap length = 45d (d = bar diameter); no laps in critical regions; ties at 1/3 intervals | Cl. 4.4 — Overlaps per IS 456 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B5 | Dowel and embed detail installation
Acceptance: Dowels centered in foundation; embed length per design; alignment verified; no misplacement | Cl. 4.5 — Connections properly embedded | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. CONCRETE PREPARATION AND POURING | | C1 | Concrete mix design and testing
Acceptance: Mix design tested; cube strength ≥ specified grade; slump within tolerance; water/cement ratio verified | Cl. 5.1 — Mix as per design | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Concrete delivery and placement
Acceptance: Delivery within 30 mins of mixing; placed in continuous layers; no segregation; vibrated properly | Cl. 5.2 — Proper concrete handling | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: Curing ≥ 28 days (or specified); moisture maintained; temperature controlled; cover kept wet | Cl. 5.3 — Curing essential for strength | OK
